mutations.name: a decrease prediction is read as an increase
kills: checkPrediction confirms a decrease prediction when the week reads at or below expected
checkPrediction misses a decrease prediction when the week reads above expected

mutations.name: an increase prediction is read as a decrease
kills: checkPrediction misses an increase prediction when the week reads below expected

mutations.name: a null reading counts as measured
kills: checkPrediction is unread when the metric is null because nothing was measured

mutations.name: the initiative key is not matched
kills: checkPrediction is unread when the only rows belong to another week or another initiative

mutations.name: a missed prediction no longer sorts first
kills: orderBetsForSheet sorts a missed prediction before a new bet in the same area
